headline: Debris from two intercepted Ansar Allah ballistic missiles fell in Mecca, Jeddah, Taif and Rabigh
dek: Saudi Civil Defence said it intercepted two ballistic missiles launched by Yemen's Ansar Allah toward the Mecca and Medina regions on Saturday, and that interception debris fell in four locations: Wadi al-Mughammas in Mecca, the al-Nuzha neighbourhood in Jeddah, Wadi Jalil in Taif, and Masturah in…
sources: Saudi Civil Defence statement (X posts + spokesperson statement); Saudi-led coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki al-Malki (earlier Saturday: two missiles toward Taif and Yanbu intercepted)
fault_line: Holy cities now inside the debris footprint: is this proof Saudi defences hold, or proof the war has reached places once thought untouchable?

sections.what_happened: Saudi Civil Defence said it intercepted two ballistic missiles launched by Yemen's Ansar Allah toward the Mecca and Medina regions on Saturday, and that interception debris fell in four locations: Wadi al-Mughammas in Mecca, the al-Nuzha neighbourhood in Jeddah, Wadi Jalil in Taif, and Masturah in Rabigh governorate. The statement reported no casualties and no damage details; approved incident procedures were implemented. Earlier Saturday the Civil Defence had issued 'potential danger' alerts for Mecca, Medina, Jeddah, Taif and Yanbu governorates, then withdrew them ('danger has passed'). This is a NEW geography versus the earlier Saturday intercepts reported as Taif/Yanbu only (totw-20261024-1500-01, 2100-01): debris now confirmed falling in Islam's holiest city. Label: PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM (Civil Defence statement as carried); the debris fall itself has no independent confirmation beyond the statement, and no Ansar Allah claim of Mecca/Medina as targets was found in-window.
sections.what_verified: Saudi Civil Defence statement carried by Reuters (via Jerusalem Post), Arab News, Gulf News, Al Arabiya and Times of Israel -- distinct publisher families reporting the same official statement, not independent eyewitness confirmation of the debris.
sections.what_disputed: None to the debris statement in-window. Counterpoint to any wider reading: the Civil Defence statement does NOT say a missile hit Mecca or Medina, only that intercepted-missile debris fell in the regions; no damage or casualties reported. The Ansar Allah have not (in-window) claimed Mecca/Medina as targets -- do not present this as a strike ON Mecca.
sections.why_matters: The war reached the map's most sensitive dot without a missile landing: intercepted over Mecca and Medina, debris fell in Mecca itself. Lead with the Civil Defence statement, name the four debris sites, and keep the line exact -- debris, not a hit.
sections.context: Background: NEW to scans (in-window, Sat Oct 24 evening) -- Saudi Civil Defence: debris from two intercepted Ansar Allah ballistic missiles fell in Mecca, Jeddah, Taif and Rabigh; missiles headed toward Mecca and Medina regions
